From: Amelia Keller <amelia.keller@ledgerwise.com>

Cc: ledgerwise-procurement@ledgerwise.com
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: priority canvas & activation guarantees for LedgerWise enterprise deal

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. LedgerWise is very interested in Redwood but we have three gating asks from security/ops and product that need to be reflected in the commercial terms before legal will sign:

1) Audit export: we need near-real-time audit/export of inference-level logs (per-tenant) to our S3 with configurable retention.
2) Per-customer retention TTLs: ability to set different retention policies per customer/tenant (not a tenant-wide flag).
3) Activation guarantees: a lightweight tenant-level KV cache pinning or residency option so our latency-sensitive customers can rely on warmed affinity (initially in us-west).

We're prepared to commit to a 2-year enterprise contract with a North America multi-region deployment and a purchase order on signature, but these three items must be scoped and a delivery cadence provided. I attached a short priority canvas (ledgerwise_priority_canvas_v1.pdf) mapping asks -> business impact.

Can you loop in your product/engineering and tell us whether these can be scoped into an activation plan? Ideally we need a response within 48 business hours so procurement can prepare draft PO.

Best,
Amelia Keller
Head of Platform Partnerships
LedgerWise

Sean / team — thanks for the summary, Laura here from Product. I've triaged the canvas and sketched rough feasibility and effort buckets below. These are initial, high-level responses — engineering will need to validate with an RFC.

A) Audit export -> S3 (per-tenant) - Feasibility: High. - Rough effort: 2 sprints to add an export sink + config surface for customers; depends on throughput SLA and encryption/KMS mapping. - Risks: throughput surprise if LedgerWise requires sub-second delivery; we'll need exact event volume estimates and retention SLOs.

B) Per-customer retention TTLs (control plane) - Feasibility: Medium. - Rough effort: 4-6 sprints. This touches metadata model and retention worker (and audits). Potential migration of existing tenant metadata required. - Risks: retention edge-cases (overlap with legal/data-subpoena workflows). Need acceptance criteria: what does "per-customer" mean operationally (UI/API only? programmatic overrides?).

C) Tenant-level KV cache pinning / residency (warm affinity) - Feasibility: Low -> Medium. - Rough effort: 8-12 sprints for a robust, production-safe implementation. This requires runtime changes to the routing layer and warm-pool orchestration; we also need telemetry hooks to ensure pinned tenants are getting expected latency. - Alternative: temporary 'activation bridge' — implement a scoped pilot on Dedicated capacity and single region (us-west) with explicit guardrails (quota, rollback) in ~6 weeks. That reduces overall product scope but gives LedgerWise the latency guarantees they need for a subset of customers.

D) Model-affinity/residency flags - Feasibility: High. - Rough effort: 3-4 sprints to expose routing policies that let us pin model variants to a tenant within existing routing controls (less invasive than cache pinning).

Recommendation: For commercial timelines, propose we split asks into "non-blocking" (A + D) and "blocking" (B + C). We can commit to A+D in the near term (Q2 sprint bucket) while working an activation bridge for C as a limited pilot. B needs product design and legal sign-off — flag as Q3 candidate unless LedgerWise can accept a staged rollout.

Please provide concrete acceptance criteria for each ask (SLO targets, expected daily event volume for audit exports, number of tenants for the residency pilot). I can turn this into an RFC template to circulate to Eng.

- Laura Bennett
Group Product Manager, Redwood Inference

2) For the export + routing-policy items (A+D) — can Product provide acceptance criteria we can send to LedgerWise procurement so legal can proceed with a conditional LOI?

We attached an updated MAP (MAP_v0.3.pdf) that trades a smaller onboarding discount in exchange for committing the pilot scope and a defined delivery window. If Eng agrees to the activation bridge pilot owner and Product provides criteria by EOD Monday, procurement will circulate a draft PO.
